analysis.insight_summary: Users established that the [product_name] ([article_no]) lacks analog input capabilities, despite initial assumptions. Documentation and manuals confirmed the absence of these inputs, leading the user to realize that a different model with analog inputs was required. The conversation highlights frequent misunderstandings due to similarities in product names and unclear descriptions regarding input types.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipated that the [product_name] [version_no] would accept analog voltage inputs and allow configuration in the settings menu. They also wondered if a firmware update could enable analog input functionality.
